first_error.why: The extraction script wrote all matches to stdout with no cap, about 7.3M characters, and the run ended without a deliverable.

divergence: All three runs failed, in three ways. T2's first store-wide extraction scan printed about 7.3M characters and the context overflowed. T0's scans timed out, and it treated the partial range output as complete (the critic flagged this and the agent moved on), so the second matter never surfaced; its answer also counted other matters. T1 ran batched scans that surfaced both matters, read both and named them, but also counted four further matters (proposed or transaction-related acceleration) that the request does not cover. The critic flagged over-inclusion at the write stage in T0 and T1; both kept the extra matters.
